laws.s1: Kebijakan pemerintah Nepal tahun 2017, terakhir diubah 2020.
laws.s2: Menetapkan syarat untuk bekerja sebagai pekerja rumah tangga di luar negeri.

coded.vi: Perekrut wajib berizin dan dapat dikenai sanksi, tetapi tidak bertanggung jawab bersama atas kewajiban majikan
coded.vl: Recruiters must be licensed and can be sanctioned, but are not jointly liable for the employer's obligations
coded.n: Recruiting agencies need a licence and a deposit; they must compensate workers if the work or pay differs from the agreement, but the Act does not make them jointly liable with the employer as such.

coded.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
coded.vi: Biaya dibatasi oleh hukum, atau dilarang hanya untuk jabatan atau negara tujuan tertentu
coded.vl: Fees are capped by law, or prohibited only for listed occupations or destinations
coded.n: Service charges are capped; under the 2015 'free visa, free ticket' decision employers in Malaysia and six Gulf states pay visa and air ticket and agencies may charge at most NPR 10,000; zero cost under government schemes.

coded.vi: Kontrak tertulis dengan syarat minimum yang ditetapkan atau diverifikasi negara wajib bagi setiap pekerja sebelum berangkat
coded.vl: A written contract with minimum terms set or verified by the state is required for every worker before departure
coded.n: A labor approval requires an employment contract with stated minimum terms, attested where required.

coded.vi: Orientasi wajib tetapi dapat dibebankan kepada pekerja, atau wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori
coded.vl: Orientation is compulsory but may be charged to the worker, or compulsory only for some categories
coded.n: Orientation training is compulsory before labor approval; workers pay a fee to approved training centers.

coded.vi: Dana berdasarkan undang-undang atau asuransi wajib mencakup semua pekerja terdaftar untuk kematian, cacat dan pemulangan, serta membiayai bantuan hukum atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
coded.vl: A statutory fund or compulsory insurance covers all registered workers for death, disability and repatriation, and funds legal or welfare assistance abroad
coded.n: Contributions to the Foreign Employment Welfare Fund and compulsory insurance are conditions of approval; the Fund pays for death, injury and repatriation and supports families.

coded.fi: Atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
coded.vi: Undang-undang mewajibkan atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di perwakilan negara tujuan utama
coded.vl: A statute requires labor or welfare officers in missions in the main destination countries
coded.n: The Act requires labor attachés in countries with large numbers of Nepali workers (more than 5,000).

coded.vi: Badan khusus di dalam negeri dapat memberi ganti rugi kepada pekerja terhadap perekrut (dan majikan asing) atas pelanggaran selama rekrutmen atau kerja
coded.vl: A specialized body at home can award compensation to workers against recruiters (and employers abroad) for breaches during recruitment or employment
coded.n: The Department can order compensation against agencies and the Foreign Employment Tribunal tries offenses under the Act and can order compensation.

coded.fn: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
coded.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
coded.vi: Pembatasan yang secara tertulis hanya berlaku bagi perempuan (usia minimum lebih tinggi, syarat izin, larangan)
coded.vl: Restrictions whose terms apply to women only (higher minimum ages, consent requirements, bans)
coded.n: Rules on domestic work abroad have applied to women only: a minimum age of 30 (2012), then 24 (2015), and suspensions of domestic work in Gulf destinations since 2016, with conditions set in 2020. Current status is to be confirmed with the Department of Foreign Employment.
coded.src: Guidelines for sending domestic workers 2074 (2017); Kathmandu Post 2015–2018; HRW 2021

coded.vi: Reintegrasi bertumpu pada kebijakan atau program tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
coded.vl: Reintegration rests on policy or programs without a statutory duty
coded.n: Reintegration services run through the Foreign Employment Board and local governments under policy and programs; no statutory duty was found in the Act.

coded.fn: Departure without sex, age or destination bans
coded.vl: Departure for domestic work broadly banned
coded.n: Women under 30 barred from domestic work in Gulf states (various decisions since 2012).

coded.vl: Contract verified or approved by a state body
coded.n: Labor permit issued against the contract.

coded.fn: No recruitment fees for domestic workers
coded.vl: Domestic workers pay no recruitment fees
Mandatory, with content specific to domestic work
coded.n: Mandatory orientation; a longer course for domestic workers.

coded.vl: Attachés in some destinations, few or no shelters
coded.n: Labor attachés in several destinations; few shelters.

coded.fn: Domestic workers at home protected by labor law

changes.en: Foreign Employment Act adopted, with a welfare fund, labor attachés and a tribunal.
'Free visa, free ticket' policy for Malaysia and six Gulf states.

dec.n: Directive to enforce the “free visa, free ticket” policy
dec.pe: Nepal decided in 2015 that employers abroad should pay for workers’ visas and tickets, but agencies kept charging workers. The Supreme Court told the government to make the rule work.
dec.pi: Nepal memutuskan pada 2015 bahwa majikan di luar negeri harus menanggung visa dan tiket pekerja, tetapi agen tetap menarik biaya dari pekerja. Mahkamah Agung memerintahkan pemerintah agar aturan itu benar-benar dijalankan.

dec.n: Order to use the Foreign Employment Welfare Fund for repatriation
dec.pe: During COVID-19, many Nepali workers lost their jobs abroad and could not pay for a flight home. The Supreme Court ordered the government to use the welfare fund that workers pay into to bring them back.
dec.pi: Selama COVID-19, banyak pekerja Nepal kehilangan pekerjaan di luar negeri dan tidak mampu membeli tiket pulang. Mahkamah Agung memerintahkan pemerintah memakai dana kesejahteraan yang dibayar para pekerja untuk memulangkan mereka.
